accounting: K=3^full*2^double; exact tax-aware payout is Gate-B-only. G_BE=[K/(0.65*H)]^(1/7) is reported only as first-order pre-tax diagnostic.
features: E_SP=sum(p*s_hat); q=p*s_hat; D=q_argmin/mean(q_other_two); scatter contains p_min, E_SP, D, entropy and uncertainty.
gate_b: UNAUTHORIZED pending independent EV and PI acceptance of this exact Gate-A package.
gm_gate: Apply threshold to the geometric mean of seven E_SP values. Geometric mean of predicted top-code SP is diagnostic only.
outcome_boundary: No result, winning SP, payout, tax, ROI, or settlement input is read or emitted.
roles: FIXED/HASH/WEIGHTED use m DOUBLE plus 7-m FULL. JOINT_ROLE uses one deterministic SINGLE (highest p_max/q_max) plus m DOUBLE and remaining FULL; m=0 is represented by full-cover control.
scope: paper-only historical research; no purchase, production, frontend, or ROI promotion.
selection: Within each accepted #101 AVAILABLE pool, select seven highest joint_match_rank_value = q_max * (1 - entropy/log(3)); ties q_max descending then match_idx ascending.
